 San Diego County Property Tax Deadline Approaches: What To Know
 County officials are reminding property owners of upcoming payment deadlines and ways to avoid late penalties.
 Kristina Houck , Patch Staff 
 Posted Wed, Oct 28, 2026 at 8:19 am PT SAN DIEGO, CA — San Diego County property owners face an upcoming deadline to pay the first installment of their 2026-27 property taxes.
 The first installment is due Nov. 1, but property owners have until Dec. 10 to pay without a late penalty, according to the San Diego County Treasurer-Tax Collector's Office .
 Payments made after Dec. 10 will be subject to a 10% penalty.

 San Diego County Treasurer-Tax Collector Larry Cohen is reminding property owners of the upcoming deadlines and encouraging residents to explore available payment options, including online payments.
